pillars.name: Alphabetic Principle
pillars.definition: Understanding that letters represent sounds and that letter combinations follow patterns and rules.

pillars.name: Phonemic Awareness
pillars.definition: The ability to hear, identify, and manipulate individual phonemes (sounds) in spoken words, without visual support.

pillars.name: Phonics
pillars.definition: The relationship between letters and sounds; the ability to use letter-sound correspondences to decode written words (decoding) and to spell words (encoding).

pillars.name: Reading Fluency
pillars.definition: Speed, accuracy, and prosody (expression) in oral and silent reading of connected text, reflecting automaticity in word recognition.

pillars.name: Vocabulary
pillars.definition: Understanding and using word meanings, both receptive (understanding words heard or read) and expressive (using words in speaking and writing).

pillars.name: Reading Comprehension
pillars.definition: Understanding and deriving meaning from written text, integrating visual symbols, phonological codes, orthographic patterns, word meanings, grammar, and discourse structure.

pillars.name: Orthography
pillars.definition: Spelling and the structure/patterns of written words, including conventions of written language and the ability to recognize and produce correctly spelled words.
